label: /map — the minimized address bar follows the section under it
notes: Wil's screenshot of 2026-09-18 (13:45): scrolled into /map's index with the address bar minimized, a grey gradient sits behind and around the bar over the brown section. Round 8 phase E measured that Safari 26 tints its bars from <body>'s background-color, and /map's body has been the map's grey #353535 since phase D/E so the at-rest bar matched the canvas — but the tint outlives the map: minimized and scrolled, it is still grey over the brown index. Phase A2 test C4a measured that a live colour change on an element that stays in the tree is the one thing that moves the tint. So on /map, and only there, <body>'s background-color now follows the colour the existing edge sampler already computes for the theme-color meta: the map's grey while the map owns the screen, the ground's brown #1d1411 once the index does — Wil's own instruction ('if you have to use a color use this one'). Nothing paints on the page: <main> covers body (round 14), so the colour reaches only the bar region and overscroll. Chapter pages, /paintings and every other route are untouched (their body colour is static and the write is gated on data-root-fill=map). allowedRoutes is empty: at scroll 0 the sampler writes the same #353535 the stylesheet already carries, so no shot may drift. Base c7baaef = the v2 tip and the live site (Actions run 245); no base branch is pushed, the SHA is the revert point.
